title: Automate Zoho Marketing Journeys with Deluge API #Shorts

angle.problem: Building complex customer journeys manually is slow and error-prone.
angle.solution: Use a Deluge function to trigger journeys via API based on CRM events.
steps: Create a custom function in CRM
Use 'invokeurl' to hit the Marketing Automation trigger API
Associate the function with a Workflow Rule
angle.result: Instant, automated customer onboarding without manual journey setup.
angle.hook: Tired of manually building customer journeys in Zoho?

story.title: Marketing Automation MCP?
story.summary: I've just started using Zoho Marketing Automation and I find it cumbersome to create all the steps of a journey. Is there a way to plug in Claude/leverage an MCP server for this? I have it connected to a lot of my tools but there seems to be a gap here. submitted by /u/tomfoolery77 [link] [comments]

script.title: Automate Zoho Marketing Journeys with Deluge API

lines.say: Tired of manually building customer journeys in Zoho? Stop wasting precious time clicking through repetitive setup tasks when you can automate the entire onboarding pipeline effortlessly.
lines.tts: Tired of manually building customer journeys in Zoho? Stop wasting precious time clicking through repetitive setup tasks when you can automate the entire onboarding pipeline effortlessly.

lines.say: Doing it step by step takes way too much time, and human error can easily disrupt your marketing campaigns, leading to missed opportunities and delayed customer engagement.
lines.tts: Doing it step by step takes way too much time, and human error can easily disrupt your marketing campaigns, leading to missed opportunities and delayed customer engagement.

lines.say: Use a custom Deluge function to trigger journeys via API automatically. This bridges your CRM data directly with Marketing Automation for seamless, instant synchronization.
lines.tts: Use a custom Deluge function to trigger journeys via API automatically. This bridges your CRM data directly with Marketing Automation for seamless, instant synchronization.

screen.heading: Functions
screen.tip: Set up your custom Deluge function

lines.say: First, create a custom function in your CRM settings and define your input arguments clearly so the script can easily grab the lead or contact details.
lines.tts: First, create a custom function in your CRM settings and define your input arguments clearly so the script can easily grab the lead or contact details.

lines.say: Next, construct your parameter map and use invokeurl to safely hit the Marketing Automation trigger endpoint, passing along the defined contact email variable.
lines.tts: Next, construct your parameter map and use invokeurl to safely hit the Marketing Automation trigger endpoint, passing along the defined contact email variable.

screen.heading: Edit Function
fields: response = invokeurl [ url: 'https://marketingautomation.zoho.com/api/v1/json/addcontact' type: POST parameters: params ];
screen.tip: Paste the API call in code

lines.say: Finally, associate this powerful function with a Workflow Rule in your CRM so it fires instantly whenever a specific deal stage updates or a new lead arrives.
lines.tts: Finally, associate this powerful function with a Workflow Rule in your CRM so it fires instantly whenever a specific deal stage updates or a new lead arrives.

lines.say: Set it up once, test your API connection, and you are completely done enjoying hands-free, high-speed automated customer onboarding every single day.
lines.tts: Set it up once, test your API connection, and you are completely done enjoying hands-free, high-speed automated customer onboarding every single day.

code.where_to_paste: Settings > Developer Space > Functions > Create New Function

test_before_recording: Verify Zoho Marketing Automation API endpoint and permissions
Check OAuth connection scope for Marketing Automation
